title: Abyssalfall
summary: Abyssalfall is a Blood Spiral spell used to create a small abyss beneath the feet of the target that can swallow the enemy. This spell is similar to Darkvoid, though is easier to escape.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
One of the Casterwill Hunters used this spell against Sophie Casterwill on the roof of the Cloisters. Lok Lambert was able to rescue her by pulling her out of the abyss. [The Casterwill Connection]

Another Casterwill Hunter used the spell on Dante Vale outside the Pyramid of the Sun, but he managed to overpower them. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Harrison Fears used the spell in his final battle against his brother Den Fears on a floating slab of rock. The spell forced the pair to jump to another rock. [Lok and the Betrayer]
